title: Danielmas Mod 1
description: A multiplayer mod that adds a command to swap players positions at certain intervals.
body:
**The first of many Danielmas mods**

Mod for multiplayer that adds a command to swap players at a certain interval. By default this is 60 secs. This can be chanegd through the /swapPlayers interval (int) command. The minimum for this command is 5 secs.

It can be used for your friends as a fun challenge on a server or in a more sadistic light (torturous and arduous attempt at beating the game) depending on the friend group.
